args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212,
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused the nightly build
tests/test_money.py to fail (e.g. 2.665 rounded up to 2.67 instead of
down to 2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so fractional cents are rounded
to the nearest even cent.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Problem

The nightly build failed: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. For example, `2.665` was rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`.

The docstring already claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the code did not match.

## Fix

Change the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money()` so fractional cents round to the nearest even cent, as specified by FIN-212.

## Verification

CI passed on this branch (commit 08d3cd5986), including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
